title: Meditation 101
subtitle: From Stillness to Practice
desc: A complete beginner's path through the science, philosophy, and practice of meditation. Move from curiosity to a daily sitting practice in five lessons.

lessons.title: Why Meditate?
lessons.desc: A clear, modern case for meditation — what it actually does and why it matters.

lessons.title: What Happens in the Brain
lessons.desc: Neuroscience explains how a consistent practice physically rewires your brain.

lessons.title: The Breath as Anchor
lessons.desc: Learn controlled breathing as the foundation for any meditation practice.

lessons.title: Your First Sitting
lessons.content: Find a quiet space. Sit comfortably with your back upright. Set a timer for 10 minutes. Bring your attention to the physical sensation of breathing — the rise of the chest, the air passing the nostrils. When your mind wanders (it will), gently return without judgment. That return IS the practice. Journal for 2 minutes after: what did you notice?

lessons.title: Building a Daily Practice
lessons.desc: How to make meditation a habit that sticks — timing, environment, and consistency.

title: Quantum Reality
subtitle: Physics at the Edge of the Known
desc: A guided journey through quantum mechanics — from the double slit experiment to quantum fields and what it all means for consciousness and reality.

lessons.title: The Double Slit Experiment
lessons.desc: The experiment that shattered our intuitions about the nature of reality.

lessons.title: Quantum Fields — What Everything Is Made Of
lessons.desc: David Tong's landmark Royal Institution lecture on quantum field theory.

lessons.title: Reflection — What Does Quantum Mean for You?
lessons.content: Consider this: quantum mechanics tells us that reality at its most fundamental level is not made of things but of possibilities — probabilities that only collapse into definite states when observed. Write for 5 minutes on what this means to you personally. Does it change how you think about consciousness, free will, or your role in reality?

lessons.title: Consciousness and the Quantum — The Open Question
lessons.desc: Quanta Magazine surveys the deepest open question in physics — the role of the observer.

title: Conscious Living Foundations
subtitle: An Orientation to the FRQNCY Network
desc: A cross-domain introduction to conscious living — covering the pillars of the FRQNCY network: consciousness, well-being, society, and creative action.

lessons.title: What is Conscious Living?
lessons.content: Before we begin — write down three questions you're currently sitting with about your life. Not problems to solve, just genuine open questions. These will be your compass through this course.

lessons.title: The Science of Manifestation
lessons.desc: Dr Joe Dispenza connects neuroscience, quantum physics, and intentional creation.

lessons.title: Vibration & Frequency
lessons.desc: Cymatics visualises the patterns that sound creates in matter — a window into vibrational reality.

lessons.title: Daily Practice — Morning Intention
lessons.content: Each morning for the next 7 days, before you check your phone: sit quietly for 3 minutes. Then write one sentence starting with 'Today I am...' — not what you'll do, but who you'll be. Notice what shifts.

lessons.title: Finding Your Network
lessons.desc: Explore the FRQNCY network map and find the three topics that pull you most. These are your signal.

title: Quantum Grammar
subtitle: The Hidden Structure of Language & Law
desc: Explore how syntax and sentence construction shape reality, commerce, and sovereignty. Discover the mathematical structure behind contracts, statutes, and the language that binds.

lessons.title: What Is Quantum Grammar?
lessons.desc: An introduction to the idea that language has a mathematical structure — and that most legal, commercial, and governmental documents are syntactically fraudulent.

lessons.title: The Syntax of Control — How Language Binds
lessons.desc: How contracts, statutes, and legal documents use specific grammatical constructions to create obligations.

lessons.title: Correct-Sentence-Structure Communication Parse-Syntax
lessons.desc: A deep dive into CSSCPSGP — the methodology for writing mathematically correct language.

lessons.title: Reflection — Deconstructing a Contract
lessons.content: Take any contract, terms of service, or legal notice you've recently signed or agreed to. Read it slowly — one sentence at a time. For each sentence, identify: Who is the subject? What is the verb? Is there a prepositional phrase that changes the meaning?

lessons.title: Language, Law & Sovereignty — The Bigger Picture
lessons.desc: How quantum grammar connects to broader questions of sovereignty, individual rights, and the hidden architecture of legal systems worldwide.

title: Crypto Fundamentals
subtitle: Sovereignty Through Decentralization
desc: Understand blockchain, Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi, and Web3 from first principles. Learn why decentralization matters — for money, for identity, and for building a more sovereign world.

lessons.title: What Is a Blockchain?
lessons.desc: An overview of distributed ledger technology — what blockchains are, how they work, and why they represent a fundamental shift in how we store, verify, and transfer information without intermediaries.

lessons.title: Bitcoin — Digital Sovereignty
lessons.desc: How Bitcoin works under the hood — mining, proof of work, the halving cycle, and why Bitcoin represents the first truly scarce digital asset.

lessons.title: Ethereum & Smart Contracts
lessons.desc: Programmable money and decentralized applications — how Ethereum extended the blockchain concept beyond currency into a world computer.

lessons.title: DeFi, DAOs & the New Economy
lessons.desc: Decentralized finance and governance — how lending, borrowing, and trading work without banks, and how DAOs rewrite the rules of collective decision-making.

lessons.title: Reflection — What Does Decentralization Mean for You?
lessons.content: Think about the systems you interact with daily — banking, social media, identity verification, communication. Which of these rely on centralized authorities? How would your life change if some of these systems were decentralized? What does sovereignty over your own money, data, and identity mean to you personally?

lessons.title: Getting Started — Wallets, Security & Your First Steps
lessons.desc: A practical guide to taking your first steps in crypto — setting up a wallet, understanding seed phrases and private keys, basic security practices, and how to navigate the ecosystem safely.

title: Working with Claude
subtitle: A FRQNCY guide to using Anthropic Claude with intention
desc: Most people use AI like a vending machine. Claude is built to work like a thoughtful collaborator. This short course teaches the prompting, the boundaries, and the practices that turn the tool into a real thinking partner.

lessons.title: Why Claude is Different
lessons.desc: The model card and the safety-first design philosophy that distinguishes Claude from other frontier AIs.

lessons.title: How to Prompt Well
lessons.desc: Anthropic's own guide to writing prompts that get the best out of the model.

lessons.title: Claude in Practice
lessons.content: Pick one task you do every week — research, writing, planning. Run it through Claude. Where does it help, where does it not, where do you need to push back? Write down what you learned.

lessons.title: Limits, Bias, and Hallucination
lessons.desc: Where the model is unreliable and how to catch it. Includes Anthropic's public research on alignment and interpretability.

lessons.title: Building a Practice
lessons.content: Most people use Claude for one-off tasks. The compound returns come from using it as a steady thinking partner. Set up one regular use — daily writing review, weekly research synthesis, fortnightly strategic reflection. Stick with it for a month.
